//overrides: Transitive advisories in the test chain. mocha is already on its latest release and its ranges still resolve to vulnerable versions, so pinning the leaves is the only route. `diff` is scoped to mocha on purpose: ts-node also depends on diff@4, which is NOT in the affected range (>=6.0.0 <8.0.3), and a global override would drag it across four majors for no security gain. The `zod` pin resolves a peer conflict, not an advisory: puppeteer's chromium-bidi asks for exactly 3.23.8 while @anthropic-ai/sdk needs >=3.25 as an optional peer, which makes a fresh `npm ci` unresolvable. 3.23->3.25 is a minor bump that chromium-bidi accepts in practice (verified: puppeteer still launches). Revisit all of these when the upstream ranges widen.
